ACT XIII OF 2017
ACT
XIII OF 2017
POLICE
ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Police Order, 2002
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 28th September, 2017]
No. PAP/Legis-2(162)/2017/1649,
dated 28.9.2017.--- The Police Order (Amendment) Bill 2017,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on September 20,
2017, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on September 27, 2017, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the
Police Order, 2002 (C. E. Order No. 22 of 2002), in its application to Province
of the Punjab, to rationalize the provisions relating to the appointment of the
Provincial Police Officer;
Be it enacted by the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Police Order
(Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in Article 11 of Order 22 of 2002
